author: egalli
title: ARM64 cross-compilation build fails with cc1plus invalid-pch error on shared cmake_pch.hxx.gch
signature: cc1plus: error: cmake_pch.hxx.gch: not a PCH file [-Werror=invalid-pch]|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure, build and install - OpenVINO JS API step fails with cc1plus invalid-pch errors

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_22_arm64_cross_compilation
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check fails because the Build job failed

key_errors: cc1plus: error: /__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/openvino_build/src/core/reference/CMakeFiles/openvino_reference.dir/cmake_pch.hxx.gch: not a PCH file [-Werror=invalid-pch]
root_cause: The JS API build step re-invokes cmake on the SAME build directory (openvino_build) with -UTBB* -DCPACK_GENERATOR=NPM -DENABLE_SYSTEM_TBB=OFF -DENABLE_WHEEL=OFF, re-using objects produced by the prior full build (which has ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD=ON, i.e. PCH enabled). Because ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD/PCH flags are not re-applied consistently across the second cmake invocation for the openvino_reference target, the cached cmake_pch.hxx.gch header file ends up stale or generated with options mismatched (ccache/sccache or PCH generation race) relative to what cc1plus expects when recompiling openvino_reference sources for the JS API variant. GCC's invalid-pch check (-Werror=invalid-pch, itself promoted from a warning because CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON) then fails the build. This is a recurring, environment/build-graph-level issue (10 prior occurrences recorded in the pattern database before this run), not something introduced by the current commit's content, which only touches MVN-6 axis validation in src/core and is unrelated to the JS API / PCH build pipeline.
reproduction_steps: Not easily reproducible outside the exact CI matrix. Locally: configure+build the full ARM64 cross-compilation target with ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD=ON, then re-run cmake on the same build dir with -UTBB* -DCPACK_GENERATOR=NPM -DENABLE_SYSTEM_TBB=OFF -DENABLE_WHEEL=OFF and rebuild openvino_reference; the stale cmake_pch.hxx.gch is likely to trigger the same invalid-pch failure if sccache/ccache serves a precompiled header that no longer matches the second configuration's compiler flags.
recommended_actions: In .github/workflows/job_build_linux.yml (or the ARM64 cross-compile job script), delete/invalidate cmake_pch.hxx.gch (or the whole CMakeFiles/openvino_reference.dir cache) before the second cmake re-configure+build pass for the JS API package step, or run that step in a separate build directory

Consider disabling ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD (PCH) for the JS-API-specific re-configure pass, or ensure PCH regeneration is forced (e.g., via `cmake --build ... --clean-first` scoped to openvino_reference) whenever CPACK_GENERATOR/TBB/WHEEL options change between cmake invocations on the same build tree
Escalate to the build-system/CI owners given this is the 10th+ recurrence over the last two weeks with no fix landed yet
prevention_strategies: Avoid re-configuring cmake on an already-built tree with different feature flags (TBB/WHEEL/CPACK_GENERATOR) while PCH is enabled; use a dedicated build directory per configuration, or explicitly purge PCH artifacts (cmake_pch.hxx.gch) whenever compiler-affecting options change between successive cmake invocations in the same directory.
historical_context: This exact signature has recurred at least 10 times since 2026-09-25 (see pattern 0ee6d7327812b344), consistently on the ARM64 cross-compilation job's JS API build step, across many unrelated PRs/commits -- confirming this is an infrastructure/build-script issue rather than a code regression introduced by any single commit.
